patch.value:
Enhance pm-jira per the 2026-06-03 release-engineer brief, scoped to offline-testable value since no live Jira creds are available.

Delivered:
1. JQL builder (buildJql) + convenience filters --project/--status/--assignee/--issue-type/--label/--updated-since composing into a single quoted JQL; --jql still verbatim. Pure + unit-tested.
2. --dry-run on BOTH import and export. Import prints JQL + exact GET request and makes ZERO network calls. Export prints the would-be POST/PUT Jira mutations from real pm items, no creds/network.
3. Field-mapping depth: statusCategory fallback, issuetype->pm type, assignee->tag, reverse priority/type maps for export, plus --map jiraField=pmField overrides. Pure + unit-tested.
4. export-on-write hook (opt-in via PM_JIRA_PUSH_ON_WRITE, best-effort no-op without creds). Added 'hooks' capability (verified active: hook_counts write:1).
5. pm jira validate diagnostics: reports cred/base-url readiness without leaking secrets (hostname-only preview), --json returns the object.
6. Manifest capability correctness: dropped phantom 'services' (never registered; #96 risk), added 'hooks'. registerExporter is gated by 'importers' (exporters is NOT a valid token).

NEEDS LIVE CREDS (could not exercise): actual JQL fetch, real issue POST/PUT on --push, live reachability. All logic feeding them is dry-run/unit verified.

author: codex
